children: Nomura expects Godrej Properties and Prestige Estates to drive residential project launches in the December quarter, with developers lining up projects worth significantly higher gross development value (GDV) than in the previous quarter.

In its monthly real estate round-up dated November 18, the brokerage said most launches for the third quarter of FY27 are stacked for end-November and December, while expressions of interest (EOIs) through channel partners and brokers remain resilient.

Nomura's discussions with mass-market developers, including Prestige Estate Projects, Godrej Properties and Lodha Developers, have not indicated any slowdown in sustenance sales from existing inventory. Sales remain largely in line with the respective companies' business plans, it said.

Godrej Properties is expected to launch projects with a combined GDV of around Rs 150 billion-Rs 200 billion in Q3FY27, compared with Rs 50 billion-Rs 60 billion in the previous quarter. Key launches include Verano in Sector 63A, Gurgaon, with a GDV of Rs 45 billion, and Bandra Bay in Mumbai, with a GDV of Rs 60 billion-Rs 70 billion.

Other projects in the pipeline include MSR City Phase 2 in North Bengaluru, Epoque in Hyderabad, Altus Vastrapur in Gujarat and Elanor Mahalunge 2. The company has indicated that sustenance sales are in line with its business plan.

Prestige Estates is expected to launch projects with a GDV of more than Rs 80 billion in Q3FY27, against Rs 26 billion in Q2FY27. These include Prestige Avon in Bengaluru, Prestige Bougainvillea Gardens in NCR and a project in Thane, Mumbai. The brokerage also highlighted larger launches lined up for the fourth quarter, including Business Bay in Mumbai, Meadows in Gurgaon and Falcon City Reserve in Bengaluru.

Lodha Developers plans to launch four projects in Q3FY27, compared with one in the previous quarter, in addition to new phases of existing projects. The launches are spread across NCR, Pune, Bengaluru and the Mumbai Metropolitan Region, with each project carrying an estimated GDV of Rs 10 billion.

DLF has Westpark Phase 2 in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region, with a GDV of Rs 10 billion-Rs 15 billion, lined up for launch. Hamilton Court, also known as Magnolias 2, with a GDV of Rs 80 billion, is expected in Q4FY27.

Oberoi Realty is likely to launch one tower at Jardin in Thane during the December quarter. Its fourth-quarter pipeline includes another tower in Thane and a luxury project on Peddar Road in Mumbai, with a GDV of Rs 40 billion.

Nomura said the escalation of the Middle East conflict and its potential adverse impact on macroeconomic conditions and customer sentiment remain key risks for the sector. However, it retained Prestige Estates as its top pick in the sector, with a Buy rating. Godrej Properties, Lodha Developers, DLF, Oberoi Realty and Aditya Birla Real Estate also carry Buy ratings from the brokerage.

title: Nomura sees Godrej Properties, Prestige Estates driving Q3 launches; sustenance sales remain resilient
